staticText: Local-first lookup over exactly 132 app-local, unverified English-isiZulu draft phrase rows in 15 categories. Pronunciation and click cues are approximate and do not fully encode tone, regional variation, noun-class agreement, voicing, aspiration or nasalisation. The table has no entry-level provenance or qualified isiZulu sign-off, is not a complete dictionary, and makes no accuracy or dialect-coverage promise. Local search, quiz, copy, TXT and print-to-PDF do not send or persist raw user text. Optional cloud translation is separate, disabled until explicit page-session consent, and unsuitable for sensitive text. Confirm every important row with a qualified isiZulu translator.
